environment.description: EKS cluster v1.28, pod deployed in namespace 'data-pipeline' with service account 'task-processor-sa'. Istio 1.20 sidecar injected with STRICT mTLS (PeerAuthentication). Namespace has an AuthorizationPolicy with spec.action DENY matching source.notNamespaces ['data-pipeline'] on all ports, combined with a second AuthorizationPolicy (ALLOW) that requires source.principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/data-pipeline/sa/task-scheduler-sa' specifically for port 50051. The mesh-level PeerAuthentication enforces STRICT mTLS so plaintext connections are rejected at the Envoy proxy before reaching the application container. Additionally, a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy selects pods with label app=task-processor and only allows ingress from pods in namespace 'data-pipeline' with label role=scheduler on port 50051.
